websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Company websites or domains, one per line, e.g. heise.de or https://www.example.de. The Impressum page is found automatically; you can also paste Impressum URLs directly.

requireEmail.title: Only keep sites with an email
requireEmail.description: Sites whose Impressum has no email address are returned as not found and not charged.

maxConcurrency.title: Sites at a time
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to read in parallel.
